scope: Independent static auxiliary signal contract, analytic branch/error and balanced-dither controls, complete short Q3/Q1.10/Q22 replay. No long training or parameter ranking.
contract: q1=flash(x); z1=4*(x-q1/4+d1/32); m1=a1*z1+b1*z1^3; aux=aa*z1+ba*z1^3 independently from the same summing node; q2=flash(aux); z2=4*(m1-q2/4+d2/32); m2=a2*z2+b2*z2^3. All phase factors zero, no memory/noise/jitter/CDAC mismatch/trim/offset; only final 8-bit TI-SAR. Never multiply nonlinear main output to manufacture independent auxiliary curvature.
parameter_provenance: Main cubic coefficients reuse EXP-057/059 assumptions. +/-3% relative gain are symmetric mechanism controls inspired by locally reviewed Q-007 reported magnitude, not a measured sign or guaranteed chip envelope. Removing auxiliary curvature is a new declared synthetic control, not a chip fit. Offsets/trim are outside this executable batch.

grid.tags: all four pairs at each midpoint
grid.digital_states: unit for all; exact linear inverse and its Q1.10 export for linear cases only; no nonlinear oracle fitting

balanced_control: Finite all-four-tag grid: exact continuous linear inverse gives all eight gated correlation sums zero even with independent auxiliary gain; ideal SAR8 and unity Q3 also give exact zero. Nonideal SAR8 correlations are outcomes, no zero gate imposed.
branch_control: Compare all same-main/dither records to paired matched auxiliary at identical fixed digital states; test raw1=512*m1+delta2 exactly; linear quantized difference includes 128*dq*(1-a2*k2), SAR epsilon difference, and arithmetic difference. Ideal mismatch preserves floor(2048*(x+1)) per sample while rear gates may change.

witness.expected: Ideal matched q2/c3=1/-47, aux0.97 q2/c3=0/81, both final2049, rear local-63/65 and third gate closed/open.

endpoints: All eight first flash thresholds +/-2^-40 and equality, four tags. Second flash standalone node probes: for each auxiliary cubic and threshold inside declared z1 domain[-1,1], 80-step rational bisection bracket with +/-2^-32 probes; exact linear preimages include equality +/-2^-40. These injected node probes do not assert stage1 input reachability. Double platform and exact rational decisions checked away from rounding-sensitive boundaries. Zero-phase result checked with three distinct prior analog states. No claim of float/exact equality at an unprotected boundary.

short.random_source: original EXP-057 counter generator; same complete input/tag record shared by all eight cases/methods
short.initial_state: all eight Q22 accumulators unity, NOT inverse initialization
short.purpose: Exercise complete physical conversions, digital-only observation boundary and all short commits; not convergence or long-run performance.

numeric: Reuse EXP-058/059 Q3 product and cumulative-offset separate nearest-even; Q1.10 export at window start; exact product sum, old-state gates with equality open, both Q22 banks one simultaneous end-window commit, next-window visibility; final nearest-even integer only scored offline. Native SAR floor((v+1)*128)-128 in original double order; exact rational floor disagreement retained and evaluated by threshold margin, never silently changed.
records: Store every grid and boundary input/tag, native three-path voltages and integer observation, Q3 fixed scores, and every short input/observation/readout/pre/post state/update/gate/support count. Source fingerprints frozen before model execution; independent verifier checks all records. No modification to prior runs or production platform/calibration/RTL.
next: Use preflight and analytic conditions to freeze necessary long static mismatch controls; preserve original step/gate/width and distinct same-learning/same-conversion budgets. Add dynamics afterward with all conversion histories. No automatic million scan from this short protocol.
